It is fair to ask whether a conclusion of this size stands alone. It does not: beginning with Spinoza and running through several modern programs, independent lines of philosophy have been arriving at much the same place from their own directions, in their own vocabularies. That agreement is evidence the conclusion is well grounded.

Chapter 2 has built the structural case from the inside. The result sits within a contemporary research program that has been independently converging on adjacent conclusions.

The historical anchor is Spinoza. The *Ethics* [-@spinoza1677] makes Nature (*Deus sive Natura*) the single necessary substance, derives modes from it by structural necessity, and grounds the modal field in nothing further. The present argument differs from Spinoza in vocabulary (T∧S∧Φ rather than substance/attribute/mode) and in method (modal logic over the structural Conditions rather than geometric deduction from definitions). It does not differ in the location of necessity (why contingency survives at the level of configurations despite the shared location of necessity is the question addressed at §2.8.4 and §2.8.5; the full Deus-sive-Natura engagement is at §5.3.1). Four contemporary lines run parallel to the structural spine of the present argument and converge on adjacent conclusions from independent directions: priority monism (§2.9.1), the modal limits on necessary-being arguments (§2.9.2), the total-theory comparison against necessary-being arguments (§2.9.3), and contemporary necessitarianism (§2.9.4). A fifth convergence (older but structurally adjacent) is the independent maturation of three formal logics each settling along one of the Conditions (§2.9.5).

The convergence matters on four points. *First*, the present argument is not an isolated thesis but the joint of several independent inquiries. *Second*, the contemporary literature has been moving toward Nature as the locus of necessity without quite naming it; the structural-triconditional decomposition T∧S∧Φ supplied here is what those inquiries have been missing as the content of their conclusion. *Third*, the convergence works in two directions: each precedent strengthens the present argument by establishing that the move is independently motivated, and the present argument strengthens each precedent by supplying the structural content their conclusions require. *Fourth*, convergence with adjacent precedents in the necessity literature is not by itself the comparative-total-theories case against naturalism's rivals. Independent motivation establishes that the move is non-isolated; it does not establish that the move's total cost (ontological commitments, explanatory loss, tensions against background commitments) is lower than the alternatives. That comparative pricing is engaged at Chapter 4 under Oppy's comparative-total-theories discipline: the necessary-being family in Chapters 5 and 6, the modal-variant family at §4.4, the physics/mind family at §4.3. The present catalog establishes literature convergence; Chapter 4 establishes comparative-cost superiority.

What the present argument adds to this program is not the conclusion but the architecture. The modal-invariance bottleneck (§2.1) supplies the modal closure. The bilateral-cogito chain (§§2.2–2.4) supplies the structural derivation of Temporality, Spatiality, and Physicality. The unity of T∧S∧Φ as the Triconditionality of Nature is supplied at §2.6, identified under three Triconditional readings: Modal, Nomological, Ontological. The necessity declaration (§2.8.5) ties the formal theorem to the named Nature. The convergence is the contemporary literature recognizing in its own vocabulary what the longer project sets out in full.

Chapter 2 closes at §2.10 by developing what the convergence makes available downstream: the three logics native to the three Conditions, the stratified scientific architecture they ground, and the metalogical position the framework owns. Chapter 3 then stress-tests the result through construction, performance, null-state closure, and grounding. It distinguishes genuinely independent lines from shared hinges, rebuilds role-level necessity without S5, and leaves proposition-wise □◇C with T1 unless a separate type-bridge is supplied. The convergence is therefore evidence of robustness where the lines separate, not a blanket claim of premise-disjoint overdetermination.[^precedent-convergence-ch4]

[^precedent-convergence-ch4]: The precedent literature is engaged dialectically in Chapter 4. Williamson's necessitism is the contemporary necessitist complement to the Della Rocca / Karofsky necessitarian line (§4.4.6), Rasmussen's foundation argument is the contemporary necessary-being program (§5.1), and Spinozist pantheism carries the Deus-sive-Natura identification (§5.3.1). Pizzi's impossibility of nothingness is the closest methodological cousin (§4.1.11), and modal fictionalism is where the modal-deflationist alternative is engaged (§4.4.4).
